dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can I ask who you are?

dialogues.speaker: Yuhua
dialogues.text: I am Xiuhua, a staff member here at the Wangshu Inn.

dialogues.speaker: Yuhua
dialogues.text: Just a regular, inconspicuous staff member.

response.speaker: Yuhua
response.text: You, you wanna know about what I do? ...Have I really been found out... Oh! Ah, nothing.

response.speaker: Yuhua
response.text: Th—The inn... could she have let slip about our mission from the Qixing? What? No, I didn't say anything...
